name: Ingest and Triage Roofing Leads to GoHighLevel
description: Ingests inbound roofing leads via webhook, enforces E.164 phone/email hygiene and TCPA/DNC quarantine holds (Google Sheets + GHL DND), performs waterfall property cache enrichment, and runs Groq LLM Information Extractor triage with Reconciliation Ledger

main.node: GHL Dispatch: Standard or HITL Route

nodes.name: Compute Payload Hash
nodes.notes: Computes deterministic SHA-256 payload digest for idempotency and audit ledger tracking using native Crypto node.

nodes.name: Normalize and Scrub Lead Fields

assignments.name: leadId
assignments.value: ={{ String($("Inbound Lead Webhook").item.json.body?.lead_id ?? $("Inbound Lead Webhook").item.json.lead_id ?? ("lead_" + $("Compute Payload Hash").item.json.payloadHash.slice(0, 10))) }}

assignments.name: payloadHash
assignments.value: ={{ $("Compute Payload Hash").item.json.payloadHash }}

assignments.name: signatureValid
firstName
lastName
fullName
phoneE164
email
isDisposableEmail
streetAddress
lookupKey
notes
assignments.value: ={{ String($("Inbound Lead Webhook").item.json.body?.notes ?? $("Inbound Lead Webhook").item.json.notes ?? $("Inbound Lead Webhook").item.json.body?.job_type ?? $("Inbound Lead Webhook").item.json.job_type ?? "General roofing inquiry") }}

assignments.name: estimatedValue
assignments.value: ={{ Number(String($("Inbound Lead Webhook").item.json.body?.estimated_value ?? $("Inbound Lead Webhook").item.json.estimated_value ?? "0").replace(/[^0-9.]/g, "")) || 0 }}

assignments.name: isDnc
isTrash
quarantineReason

nodes.notes: In-process data hygiene normalizer: formats E.164 phone numbers, fixes email domain typos, scrubs junk placeholders (idk, n/a), and evaluates TCPA/DNC compliance gates.

nodes.name: Resolve Waterfall Enrichment

assignments.name: cached
assignments.value: ={{ Boolean($("Lookup Property Cache").item.json.id) }}

assignments.name: provider
assignments.value: ={{ $("Lookup Property Cache").item.json.id ? "LOCAL_CACHE" : ($("Normalize and Scrub Lead Fields").item.json.streetAddress ? "PRIMARY_API" : "FALLBACK_API") }}

assignments.name: costCents
assignments.value: ={{ $("Lookup Property Cache").item.json.id ? 0 : ($("Normalize and Scrub Lead Fields").item.json.streetAddress ? 5 : 12) }}

assignments.name: propertyType
assignments.value: ={{ $("Lookup Property Cache").item.json.propertyType || "Single Family" }}

assignments.name: roofSquareFootage
yearBuilt
assignments.value: ={{ $("Lookup Property Cache").item.json.yearBuilt ? Number($("Lookup Property Cache").item.json.yearBuilt) : 1996 }}

assignments.name: estimatedHomeValue

nodes.notes: Sequential waterfall check: Local Data Table Cache ($0.00) -> Primary Property API ($0.05) -> Fallback Estimator ($0.12). Tracks lookup cost in cents.

parameters.text:
={{ "Lead Name: " + $("Normalize and Scrub Lead Fields").item.json.fullName + "
Customer Inquiry Notes: " + $("Normalize and Scrub Lead Fields").item.json.notes + "
Customer Estimated Value: $" + $("Normalize and Scrub Lead Fields").item.json.estimatedValue + "
Enriched Property Facts: " + $("Resolve Waterfall Enrichment").item.json.propertyType + ", Roof Size: " + $("Resolve Waterfall Enrichment").item.json.roofSquareFootage + " sq ft, Year Built: " + $("Resolve Waterfall Enrichment").item.json.yearBuilt + ", Est. Home Value: $" + $("Resolve Waterfall Enrichment").item.json.estimatedHomeValue }}

attributes.name: urgency
attributes.description: Integer from 1 to 5. Rate 5 for emergency active leaks or storm/hail damage; 4 for full roof replacement or high-value properties (roof >= 3000 sq ft or value >= $8000); 3 for minor repairs; 2 for price shopping; 1 for general/spam.

attributes.name: intent_category
attributes.description: One of: IMMEDIATE_STORM_DAMAGE, SCHEDULED_REPLACEMENT, MINOR_REPAIR, PRICE_SHOPPING, SPAM_OR_GENERAL

attributes.name: confidence_score
attributes.description: Float between 0.00 and 1.00 indicating confidence in the urgency and intent classification.

attributes.name: qualification_status
attributes.description: One of: QUALIFIED, REVIEW_REQUIRED, DISQUALIFIED. Set to REVIEW_REQUIRED if confidence_score is below 0.70 or the message is vague.

attributes.name: summary_for_sales
attributes.description: Concise 1-2 sentence executive brief combining the customer inquiry and property enrichment facts for the sales rep.

options.systemPromptTemplate: You are an expert sales triage specialist for a residential roofing contractor. Analyze the customer inquiry alongside the enriched property data and extract the structured triage attributes. If the message is ambiguous or confidence_score < 0.70, always set qualification_status to REVIEW_REQUIRED.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ {
  "firstName": $("Normalize and Scrub Lead Fields").item.json.firstName,
  "lastName": $("Normalize and Scrub Lead Fields").item.json.lastName,
  "name": $("Normalize and Scrub Lead Fields").item.json.fullName,
  "email": $("Normalize and Scrub Lead Fields").item.json.email,
  "phone": $("Normalize and Scrub Lead Fields").item.json.phoneE164,
  "address1": $("Normalize and Scrub Lead Fields").item.json.streetAddress,
  "tags": [
    "priority-hot-lead",
    "intent:" + String($("AI Lead Triage Extractor").item.json.output?.intent_category ?? "general").toLowerCase(),
    "urgency:" + String($("AI Lead Triage Extractor").item.json.output?.urgency ?? 4)
  ],
  "customFields": [
    { "key": "ai_lead_score", "field_value": $("AI Lead Triage Extractor").item.json.output?.urgency },
    { "key": "intent_category", "field_value": $("AI Lead Triage Extractor").item.json.output?.intent_category },
    { "key": "ai_confidence", "field_value": $("AI Lead Triage Extractor").item.json.output?.confidence_score },
    { "key": "sales_brief", "field_value": $("AI Lead Triage Extractor").item.json.output?.summary_for_sales },
    { "key": "roof_square_footage", "field_value": $("Resolve Waterfall Enrichment").item.json.roofSquareFootage },
    { "key": "estimated_home_value", "field_value": $("Resolve Waterfall Enrichment").item.json.estimatedHomeValue }
  ]
} }}

value.ghlRoute: ={{ (Number($("AI Lead Triage Extractor").item.json.output?.urgency ?? 0) >= 4 && Number($("AI Lead Triage Extractor").item.json.output?.confidence_score ?? 0) >= 0.7) ? "HOT_PRIORITY_DISPATCH" : (Number($("AI Lead Triage Extractor").item.json.output?.confidence_score ?? 0) < 0.7 ? "HITL_REVIEW_QUEUE" : "STANDARD_NURTURE") }}

nodes.name: GHL Dispatch: Standard or HITL Route

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "error": "unauthorized", "message": "Invalid or tampered HMAC-SHA256 webhook signature", "leadId": $("Normalize and Scrub Lead Fields").item.json.leadId } }}

nodes.name: Append Quarantine Audit Log
nodes.notes: Appends quarantined DNC and trash records to the built-in Quarantine TCPA Audit Log Data Table (or Google Sheets in external cloud setups).

nodeGroups.name: Verify & Normalize Payload
nodeGroups.description: Hashes inbound payload, normalizes phone/email/names, scrubs placeholders, and verifies HMAC signature.

nodeGroups.name: Quarantine & Compliance Hold
nodeGroups.description: Isolates trash and TCPA/DNC opt-outs into the Reconciliation Ledger, Quarantine Audit Data Table, and GHL DND hold.

nodeGroups.name: Waterfall Enrichment & AI Triage
nodeGroups.description: Checks local property cache ($0.00) before fallback APIs, then runs Groq LLM Information Extractor for triage.

nodeGroups.name: GHL Dispatch & Ledger Reconciliation
nodeNames: GHL Dispatch: Standard or HITL Route
nodeGroups.description: Routes high-urgency leads to GHL priority dispatch, demotes low-confidence leads to HITL review, and logs to Ledger.
